        "Read all 395 lines of the exact eight-path owned diff: build registration, test setup and manifest, the new mock and smoke test, Cargo dependency edge, and Rust transport changes. The later reusable MockServer data-storage phase is separate.",
        "The initial GraphServer exposes only /me and returns fixed public example data. Its dispatcher checks Basic credentials only when an Authorization header is present and begins with Basic. Missing or other authorization schemes proceed. It dispatches by path without a method/query oracle; unexpected paths throw. The accepted server later adds Bearer validation, mandatory v1.0 paths and method-based dispatch, while absent authorization still reaches dispatch. This does not establish production authorization behavior.",
        "The new test starts a local mock, configures a graph incoming server and awaits PromiseUrlListener after verifyLogon. The actual shared listener resolves only on NS_OK and rejects other completion codes. There are no explicit Assert sites, response-field checks, header/query checks or rejected-credential scenarios in the added test. The current combined EWS/Graph task retains this success-completion oracle.",
        "Historical check_connectivity builds /me selecting AboutMe, parses a User response and reports success/failure through the listener. The client clones the endpoint URL, copies the request query separately, appends split path segments and joins the resulting URL. This replaces string concatenation that mixed the relative URI/query with the path. Empty-segment, unusual endpoint and malformed-response cases are not independently tested here.",
        "The owned transport adds a UUID for request/status logs and conditionally logs the response body when env::var(THUNDERBIRD_LOG_NETWORK_PAYLOADS).is_ok(). The code checks a Unicode-readable environment value, not a particular value. No environment value or payload logging was exercised. Review discussion about S: is a proposal followed by the author's Server explanation; the owned source retains S:.",
        "At the fixed accepted revision, connectivity supplies an endpoint-aware generated builder, base_api_url appends v1.0 and send_request builds before queued transport.
